newsitem.title: USA: General Mills sets snack venture in China.
newsitem.headline: General Mills sets snack venture in China.

text.p: General Mills Inc. said Tuesday it will establish a snack joint venture in China with Want Want Holdings Ltd, China's number one manufacturer and marketer of rice crackers.
Each company will share equally in the ownership of and investment in the new venture.

The venture between General Mills and Want Want Holdings Ltd will be managed by a chief executive and other officers appointed by a board of directors that will have equal representation from both partners. Headquarters are expected to be located in China, the companies said.
Other terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

"The venture combines our technological expertise in grain-based snacks with Want Want's strong knowledge of the market and their well-established sales, manufacturing and distribution systems, which are critical for success in China," said Stephen Sanger, General Mills chairman and CEO.

"We believe this partnership with General Mills will help us toward our goal of developing Want Want into a broadly diversified food company," said Tsai Eng Meng, Want Want's chairman. -- ((Reuters Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
